summary: First week of a brand-new relationship: the group was set up 8/3, the team introduced roles same-day (chatting/page management, social, promo, invoicing), and Ollie logged in and audited the OF page immediately. Alanna shared her full content library plus five scenes to schedule (Aug 10-29), asked for an impersonating Instagram to be removed (Derrek submitted a takedown), and ended the week praising the chatting. Open threads: the FAQ form Ollie asked her to fill is still unconfirmed after a bump, the 8/3 collab release only got trailer approval on 8/7 with no confirmation it went out, and nobody on the team acknowledged the five-scene schedule whose first date is Aug 10.

health.rationale: Strong onboarding and explicit client praise, but three loose ends (FAQ form, collab release confirmation, unacknowledged Aug 10+ scene schedule) keep it just under smooth.
